pages.text: $(l)G$() locks onto the nearest foe; the arrow keys or middle mouse move the lock. Fighting a boss without lock-on is a bold choice.$(br2)Prefer fighting in third person? $(l)Mods > Epic Fight > Config$(): turn on $(l)Camera Auto Switch$() (battle stance swaps to third person) and set $(l)TPS Perspective$() to $(l)Always$() for an over-the-shoulder view.
